title: "Quizkit demo"

A demo of quizkit.

::: {.quiz lockout="5"}

::: {.question}
What is 2 + 2?

- [ ] [3]{explanation="Close, but 2 + 2 = 4."}
- [x] 4
- [ ] 5
:::

::: {.question}
Which are prime? (select all)

- [x] 2
- [x] 3
- [ ] 4
- [x] 5

::: {.feedback}
A prime has exactly two divisors: 1 and itself.
:::
:::

::: {.question answer="7" tolerance="0"}
How many integers x satisfy |x - 10| ≤ 3? Type the number.
:::

::: {.question .kprim}
Rate each statement.

- [x] Every integer is a rational number.
- [ ] Pi is a rational number.
:::

::: {.reveal}
Nicely done — you finished the demo quiz.
:::
